reviews.text: Very Knowledgeable and Caring Staff !!  Always Very Helpful  ! I've been boarding my dog here for many years and also Grooming him here .  VERY SATISFIED  !!!

I had took my 9 month old teacup Yorkie to get here month to month groom to this place as I wanted to try somewhere closer to home as she really doesn’t like to be outside as of this moment.I saw this place had positive reviews over the years so I was open to the experience .For one the groomer himself didn’t even know he was grooming my dog,there’s no communication between the two at all .I asked her to make sure and let the groomer know I didn’t want a short cuz I want a full face just trimmed and the hair on the body cut a little shorter than what it was.She gave me the okay so I left and waited .Five o’clock comes and she’s not finished no problem I’m not in a rush so I sit inside.Not to bring another customer in it but she stressed about how much hair was shedding on her clothing when she reunited with her dog she brought it up twice in fact.But okay not my business there are puppies and birds in cages no food and room temperature water in this heat and she finally feeds them while I’m waiting as I said out loud they were hungry because they were butting the bowls.My dog comes out and she has a cut almost as if she was matted and at first I didn’t say anything because I’m not confrontational but she was looking as if she was confused so I expressed to her how disappointed I was because I have only 2 simple request that would’ve honestly saved both parties time and that I wouldn’t be coming back but thank you anyways .The environment is very unsanitary which is one of the major reasons I will not bring my dog back here there I don’t know how there are so many positive reviews aside from maybe the price honestly

I can't express enough how grateful I am for Zoo-Rama . A year ago, I bought a beautiful Goldendoodle from their shop, and it has been one of the best decisions of my life. From the moment I brought my new furry friend home, it was clear that the staff at Zoo-Rama had done an amazing job with his early care and training.

Our Goldendoodle has a remarkably calm and well-behaved personality. He quickly adjusted to his new home and became a beloved member of our family. Zoo-Rama provided me with all the necessary information and resources to ensure a smooth transition.

I highly recommend Zoo-Rama to anyone looking to buy a pet. The owners dedication to the animals and their new families is unmatched.
I brought my puppy from them in August and they are so attentive and caring even after the fact. They have accommodated me greatly and answer any questions or concerns I have.
